notes: Names added are the spellings of data/countries.geojson (property 'country'), the source of the 'country' column written by model/run_global.py through location_tools.build_country_lookup_by_cell_overlap.

Northern Cyprus is mapped to CYP and Somaliland to SOM (de facto entities without their own ISO3); Kosovo uses the user-assigned code XKX. Antarctica, the Falkland Islands and the French Southern Lands receive their ISO3 codes but hold no demand in green-porpoise.
Cells with no country polygon overlap (NaN country) are dropped by export_lory_surface.py --drop-unassigned and counted in the contract.
